newsitem.title: UK: UK C&W in support deal with Palestine PALTEL.
newsitem.headline: UK C&W in support deal with Palestine PALTEL.

text.p: Britain's Cable and Wireless Plc said on Tuesday it had agreed to provide management and development support to Palestine's telecommunications group PALTEL.

C&W said the two-year contract was worth between $1.0 million and $2.0 million per annum. It said PALTEL was aiming to provide national and international services to two million people in the West Bank and Gaza.
C&W said Palestine's telecommunications sector was privatised earlier this year as part of President Yasser Arafat's national infrastructure policy.
